{{Top|leg}}
A '''cart''' was a primitive two-wheeled [[Wagon/Legends|wagon]] vehicle.

==History==
[[File:Dewbackcart.jpg|thumb|250px|Tatooine farm cart]]
Cart-type vehicles were used on multiple [[Planet/Legends|planets]], such as [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]], where they were pulled by [[Cerean pack animal]]s.

On [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], carts were used by [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] and sometimes drawn by [[Dewback/Legends|dewbacks]]. A smaller, two-wheeled variation of a cart pushed by [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droids]] was in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

A variant of cart dubbed the [[taxicart]] was used in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pelek Baw/Legends|Pelek Baw]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]].<ref name="MrGlass">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>

The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] natives of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] used carts and harnessed them to pack animals. The [[Quork/Legends|Quorks]] from Endor used carts to pull loads of [[hay]].

Carts were also used by the farm villagers of the planet [[Jomark/Legends|Jomark]].
